# Angel Pineda

> Angel Pineda is a freelance software engineer based in Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico,
> with 5+ years of experience building end-to-end web products for entrepreneurs and
> businesses across Mexico and Latin America. He handles discovery, strategy, design,
> development, and deployment under one process — so clients move from idea to
> production without switching vendors or losing momentum.

## Services

Angel Pineda offers four phases of engagement for web product development:

**Discovery** — Scoping sessions to understand business goals, target users, and technical
requirements before committing to scope. Clients leave this phase with a clear scope
document, a realistic timeline, and a confirmed plan before any code is written.

**Design and Strategy** — Architecture planning, interface direction, UX design in Figma,
and a delivery roadmap that can grow with the product. Clients receive a clickable
prototype and delivery roadmap before development begins.

**Development** — Building fast, modern, and maintainable web applications using React,
Astro, Node.js, Express.js, PHP, and Laravel. Emphasis on clarity, long-term
maintainability, and staging environments for client review.

**Deployment** — Production launch, performance optimization, domain and hosting setup,
and a documented release process for future updates.

## Featured Project

**Nutrióloga Monserrat** (monserratherrera.com) — A wellness-focused web experience for
a nutrition specialist in Mexico who helps patients improve their digestive and metabolic
health. The site integrates a scheduling calendar that allows patients to book their first
consultation directly online, eliminating manual coordination and reducing appointment
friction to a single click.

## Technology Stack

React, Astro, Node.js, Express.js, PHP, Laravel, Figma, AI integration (LLM APIs,
automated workflows, content generation pipelines)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does a project cost?**
Pricing is scoped to the specific product. Landing pages and focused web presences
typically start around $750–$1,500 USD ($15,000–$30,000 MXN). Full web applications
with custom functionality, integrations, and multi-user flows run higher depending on
complexity. Every engagement begins with a discovery conversation to define scope before
any number is confirmed.

**How long does development take?**
A focused landing page or web presence can ship in three to four weeks. A full product
with multiple user flows, third-party integrations, and custom backend logic typically
takes eight to sixteen weeks. What adds time: additional user roles, payment gateways,
CRM integrations, multi-language support, and extended review cycles.

**Can you work with an existing system or team?**
Yes. Angel can collaborate directly in an existing codebase, follow a team's workflow,
and integrate with tools like GitHub, Slack, Notion, or Linear. Improvements, redesigns,
and new functionality on existing products are a common and comfortable starting point.

**What types of businesses does Angel work with?**
Entrepreneurs and independent professionals launching their first web presence. Small and
medium-sized businesses that need a new or improved site. Startups and product teams
seeking a reliable development partner. Past work includes wellness and healthcare
professionals, logistics and operations tooling, and fintech-adjacent platforms.

**Where is Angel based and does he work remotely?**
Based in Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico. All client work is done remotely across Mexico and
Latin America. Works in Spanish and English.

## About

Angel Pineda takes a systems-thinking approach to web product development — adapting
technology to the problem rather than forcing the problem to fit a predetermined tool.
He started building web products for local businesses and independent professionals in
Guadalajara and grew into more complex product challenges across logistics, healthcare,
and operations tooling.
